title: When the Wreck Wakes
author: Casper Vasquez
blurb: Beatrix Marchetti, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
